ruleDefinitions.name: DLL Execution via Rasautou.exe
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects using Rasautou.exe for loading arbitrary .DLL specified in -d option and executes the export specified in -p.

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\\\rasautou\\\.exe$") OR process_original_file_name = "rasdlui\.exe") AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-d\\ .*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-p\\ .*")))
